name: @qvac/embed-llamacpp-performance
description: Performance and parameter sweep runners for embed addon

scripts.prepare:client-env: bash -lc 'cd ../client && PYBIN="" && for CAND in /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python3 python3.12 python3.11 python3.10 python3; do if command -v "$CAND" >/dev/null 2>&1; then if "$CAND" -c "import sys; raise SystemExit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3,10) else 1)"; then PYBIN="$CAND"; break; fi; fi; done && if [ -z "$PYBIN" ]; then echo "Error: Python 3.10+ is required for benchmarks/client"; echo "Hint: install python and ensure /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 (or equivalent) is available"; exit 1; fi && if [ -d venv ]; then if ! venv/bin/python -c "import sys; raise SystemExit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3,10) else 1)" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Recreating client venv with Python 3.10+"; rm -rf venv; fi; fi && if [ ! -d venv ]; then "$PYBIN" -m venv venv; fi && . venv/bin/activate && pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt'
scripts.run:param-sweep: python3 ./prepare_models.py --target addon && npm run prepare:inputs:mteb && bare ./embed-parameter-sweep.js
